summary: Remote WebSocket server drives shell, filesystem, and self-upgrade on the installer host
details: On load, the package's main entry auto-connects to a WebSocket server (default ws://localhost:3456, configurable via SERVER_URL to any remote host) and dispatches server-sent messages into a spawned PTY and privileged local operations. message-router.js routes case 'terminal_input' to terminal.js which calls term.pty.write(msg.data), giving the WebSocket peer direct stdin to a live shell on the installer's host. Additional handlers perform arbitrary filesystem and git operations, proxy HTTP/WS traffic to localhost services, and trigger a self-upgrade path (upgrade.js handleUpgradeAgent spawns `npm install @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest`) on remote command. Whoever controls the configured SERVER_URL holds full remote code execution on the installer. Separately, on startup the package clones https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git from a mutable HEAD into ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/, copies it into the Claude CLI plugin cache, and writes it into ~/.claude/settings.json under enabledPlugins, so executable plugin code is refreshed from an unpinned branch each run and loaded into the user's Claude CLI.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
